spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    latitude,
    longitude,
    bssid,
    manufacturer,
    signal_dbm,
    wps_state,
    encryption_type
FROM (
    SELECT
        lat AS latitude,
        lon AS longitude,
        bssid,

        CASE
            WHEN manufacturer IS NULL THEN 'Desconocido'
            WHEN TRIM(manufacturer) = '' THEN 'Desconocido'
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(manufacturer)) = 'unknown' THEN 'Desconocido'
            ELSE TRIM(manufacturer)
        END AS manufacturer,

        signal_dbm,

        CASE
            WHEN wps_state = 1 THEN 'Activado'
            ELSE 'Desactivado'
        END AS wps_state,

        CASE
            WHEN encryption ILIKE '%WPA3%' THEN 'WPA3'
            WHEN encryption ILIKE '%WPA2%' THEN 'WPA2'
            WHEN encryption ILIKE '%WPA%'  THEN 'WPA'
            WHEN encryption ILIKE '%WEP%'  THEN 'WEP'
            WHEN encryption IS NULL OR TRIM(encryption) = '' THEN 'Open'
            WHEN encryption ILIKE '%OPEN%' THEN 'Open'
            WHEN encryption ILIKE '%NONE%' THEN 'Open'
            ELSE 'Otro'
        END AS encryption_type

    FROM wardriving.wifi_network
    WHERE lat IS NOT NULL
      AND lon IS NOT NULL
      AND lat <> 0
      AND lon <> 0
) t
WHERE
    (
        '${WPS:raw}' = 'All'
        OR wps_state IN (${WPS:sqlstring})
    )
AND (
        '${Fabricante:raw}' = 'All'
        OR manufacturer IN (${Fabricante:sqlstring})
    )
AND (
        '${Cifrado:raw}' = 'All'
        OR encryption_type IN (${Cifrado:sqlstring})
    );

            WHEN encryption ILIKE '%WEP%'  THEN 'WEP'
            WHEN encryption IS NULL OR TRIM(encryption) = '' THEN 'Open'
            WHEN encryption ILIKE '%OPEN%' THEN 'Open'
